import re
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

NAVY = "1F3864"
RAG = {"RED": "F4B6B6", "AMBER": "FFE699", "GREEN": "C6EFCE", "GREY": "D9D9D9"}

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    for old in tcPr.findall(qn("w:shd")):
        tcPr.remove(old)
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text, size=None, color=None, italic=False):
    parts = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*)", text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part:
            continue
        bold = part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**")
        t = part[2:-2] if bold else part
        r = p.add_run(t)
        r.bold = bold
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return p

def para(doc, text, size=10, style=None, italic=False, space_after=4, align=None, color=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else doc.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, italic=italic, color=color)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return p

def bullet(doc, text, size=10, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def numbered(doc, text, size=10):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def heading(doc, text, level=1):
    h = doc.add_heading(text, level=level)
    for r in h.runs:
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(NAVY)
    return h

def set_repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader")
    el.set(qn("w:val"), "true")
    trPr.append(el)

def table(doc, headers, rows, widths, size=8, rag_col=None, first_col_bold=False):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    hdr = t.rows[0]
    set_repeat_header(hdr)
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = hdr.cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h)
        r.bold = True
        r.font.size = Pt(size)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
        shade(c, NAVY)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                txt = line
                if first_col_bold and i == 0 and not txt.startswith("**"):
                    txt = "**" + txt + "**" if txt else txt
                add_runs(p, txt, size=size)
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
            if rag_col is not None and i == rag_col:
                key = str(val).split()[0].upper() if str(val).strip() else ""
                if key in RAG:
                    shade(c, RAG[key])
    for row in t.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    # tblGrid widths
    grid = t._tbl.tblGrid
    for i, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[i] * 1440)))
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run = paragraph.add_run()
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = "PAGE"
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    run._r.append(f1); run._r.append(it); run._r.append(f2)
    run.font.size = Pt(8)

def new_doc():
    doc = Document()
    sec = doc.sections[0]
    sec.orientation = WD_ORIENT.LANDSCAPE
    sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Inches(11), Inches(8.5)
    for m in ("left_margin", "right_margin"):
        setattr(sec, m, Inches(0.6))
    sec.top_margin = Inches(0.6); sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.6)
    st = doc.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"; st.font.size = Pt(10)
    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]
    add_runs(hp, "PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL | ATTORNEY-CLIENT COMMUNICATION / ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT | DRAFT FOR DEAL-TEAM DISCUSSION", size=7, color="7F7F7F")
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

    add_runs(fp, "In re Oakvale Industrial Holdings, Inc., Case No. 24-10387-KBO (Bankr. D. Del.) | Effective Date Conditions Checklist | Page ", size=8, color="7F7F7F")
    add_page_number(fp)
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return doc
